en.topic_title: Policy Address 2026: Hong Kong to standardise cigarette pack designs in bid to discourage smoking
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong will standardise designs on all cigarette packs starting from the end of next year in a bid to discourage residents from smoking, the city’s leader John Lee has announced.



A man smoking on the waterfront promenade at Tsim Sha Tsui on September 5, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



Lee made the announcement during his annual Policy Address on Wednesday, after the government gazetted subsidiary legislation last week that will strip cigarette packs of their designs and replace them
